answer: Subnet-priced attestation makes crowds pay for sharing one inlet to the network. First, every attestation carries a small fee, 0.1 POA. Second, the ledger groups signers by /24 subnet and ASN. Third, each extra account voting from the same subnet in one epoch doubles that fee, so the tenth costs 51.2 POA. Fourth, fees burn, and the ember of any refund goes only to lone voters. Swinging one vote with 400 fakes means renting about 400 residential proxies at $3 a month, $1,200, before fees. It is a toll road on a long voyage where every car in a convoy pays twice the last.
